me.title: About Me
me.description: Learn more about my background, skills, and experience.
content: I am a software engineer and tech lead with more than five years of experience building digital products, internal platforms, and scalable services. My work has grown from frontend development into a broader technical scope that includes backend, infrastructure, observability, architecture support, and delivery leadership.

I worked across frontend, backend, and infrastructure, supporting solutions in Java with Spring Boot, frontend architecture with clean code practices, and application structure decisions for scalable services and teams.

I also worked with Google Cloud Platform, observability in Datadog, monitor creation for backend and frontend error tracking, GitHub Actions workflows for unit tests and pull request feedback, deployment pipelines, semantic versioning, and environment organization across development and production.

My main strengths include web application development, technical decision support, delivery planning, documentation, performance, debugging, unit tests, and building solutions that connect code quality with business needs.

I have a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from FATEC and an IT technician from ETEC. I am passionate about web application development and automation, and I am always looking to learn new technologies and methodologies.

I am a committed, creative, and collaborative professional, who likes to work as a team and solve problems. I am proud to have been awarded at two innovation events, Ideathon and Inovathon São Paulo, where I presented solutions to the challenges of the digital environment and culture and tourism. My goal is to continue developing solutions that generate value for customers and society.

resume.name: Rafael Lima Amaral Fachinelli
resume.summary: I am a software engineer and tech lead with more than five years of experience building digital products, internal platforms, and scalable services. Over time, my work has expanded from frontend development into a broader technical scope that includes backend, infrastructure, observability, architecture support, and delivery leadership. I have worked with technologies such as React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, MySQL, Google Cloud Platform, Datadog, Docker, Kubernetes, Firebase, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD workflows. My experience includes technical leadership over more than 40 microservices, support for architectural decisions, monitor creation for backend and frontend systems, deployment and environment organization, semantic versioning, unit test automation, and the definition of engineering standards that connect code quality with business needs.

personalManifesto.title: Personal Manifesto
personalManifesto.description: My core values and principles that guide my work and life.
content: **I don't seek to be perfect. I seek to be whole.**
I want to understand before judging, build before criticizing, and feel before deciding.
My mind works like a system: I like to see the logic, the flows, the patterns. But my heart doesn't accept automatisms. It pulls me back to meaning — to what is just, human, true.
I push myself because I care. I pay attention to details because I know the weight of consequences. Sometimes this overwhelms me. But I don't regret trying to do things right.

I observe the world with attention. I like well-placed silences, honest conversations, and ideas that have foundation. I like to create things that speak for me, that express what doesn't fit in words.
**I don't want to control everything — I want to understand better.**
**I don't want to convince everyone — I want to be understood.**
*And if something I do touches someone, then it was worth it.*
